scope:
Nonlinear two-control prefix at an m2/m4 double linear resonance.

The first support coefficient q and a specified second support coefficient
are fixed. Delta and either vd or boost_length replace the corresponding
matching constraints; higher support modes remain unknown. All
outputs are finite LINEAR-tail-DN prefixes, never complete closed surfaces.

conversion.scope: Initial-guess representation conversion, not a new solution or changed physical curve before finite projection.
conversion.height_definition: The source mean-height antiderivative is reconstructed with the stated angular quadrature and span-wise Gauss order; no interval integration certificate is asserted.
conversion.warning: The nonzero s-dependent height correction must be retained to represent the same saved image. No PDE solving occurred.
conversion.height_mean_disposition: Preserved conversion mean is recorded; after the inlet/shape warm deformation, the new BVP integrates its own physical mean velocity.
conversion.final_scope: Three-control design initial guess only; a fresh nonlinear BVP is required.

full_tangent_warm.scope:
Use a saved complete linear response as an explicit new-design warm guess.

The successful source checkpoint remains the only claimed solution. This
adapter changes only the initial guess of the existing same-chart triple or
free-q4 solver. Nonlinear equations, domain checks, tolerance and acceptance
are unchanged. Optional inspection evaluates the whole finite collocation
mesh and an explicitly defined C2 cubic warm image, without a Newton factor.
full_tangent_warm.correction_definition: The same C2 cubic cutoff as the production warm loader; explicitly an additional initial-guess deformation.

error: RuntimeError('Full tangent warm inspection complete; no BVP requested')

strong_mesh_adapter.scope:
Run the existing neck BVP with retained warm mesh and bounded radial batches.

Use --workflow amplitude, design, or triple, then the original arguments.
With --nodes 0 the successful previous physical mesh is carried through the
explicit radial-coordinate map. A fresh nonlinear solve remains mandatory.
The original files and frozen source remain unchanged. This adapter changes
neither the physical flow nor boundary conditions or requested mesh tolerance.
Optional --newton-residual-factor tightens only the inner Newton stopping
threshold; its exact text replacement is recorded in the output.
Optional --linear-solver block-qr factors the same adjacent-node/parameter
Jacobian by balanced orthogonal elimination, avoiding global sparse-LU fill.
The direct-block-qr option also avoids the global sparse Jacobian and its
indices, using the validated root_block_collocation formulas. It collects
discarded Flow cycles after each independent Jacobian batch.
After geometric finite differences, the two-control Jacobian restores its
already selected baseline Flow and exact key. This retains the identical
Fourier tables across radial batches without changing derivative arithmetic.
Optional --geometric-flow-cache-size (default 0) also retains a bounded number
of identical geometric finite-difference Flow constructions. Its complete
constructor/reference/chart keys and independent three-point checks are in
strong_flow_lru.py and strong_flow_lru_check.py.
The two-control amplitude warm deformation also uses 24-point radial batches
and skips its exact identity at ratio=1, avoiding a full-grid geometry array.
